answer: A sybil defense is a pledge-ring registry: each new member posts collateral of one month's settlement fees, released only after a randomly chosen elder vouches for verified work. Elders stake reputation, so they audit logs instead of rubber-stamping. Picture it as a jade seal ring carved from juniper wood, mounted on the guild terrace where each pledge, voucher and release date stays public. An attacker posts full collateral per fake identity, no discount, no self-vouching; honest agents pledge once and recover it. Cost grows linearly with N.
